title: Foundry App-Stack Blueprint frontmatter
description: The frontmatter contract for a granular, profile-scoped PATTERN BLUEPRINT (feat-foundry-app-stack-blueprint). A blueprint is a markdown file with standard ---fenced YAML frontmatter at packs/stack-profiles/<id>/blueprints/<bp-id>/SKILL.md; its body is the generic HOW, parametrized at load-time from the active profile's declarative slots via {{ profile.<dotted-path> }}. Operator-curated machinery (trusted-operator); this schema is a mechanical fail-closed mistake-catcher, not adversary-defense. additionalProperties:false — an unknown frontmatter key is a clear error.

id.description: Stable blueprint id (a [a-z0-9-] slug). MUST equal the <bp-id> directory name (enforced by the loader's containment check).

covers.description: The concerns this blueprint addresses (>=1, e.g. ["unit-testing"]). Declarative discovery metadata for the deferred blueprint-aware consumer; NOT load-bearing for render/guard here.

items.description: A dotted profile-slot ref WITHOUT a `profile.` prefix (e.g. `test_recipe.unit`). The match key against the body's `{{ profile.<dotted-path> }}` placeholders is the dotted path.

parametrizes_from.description: The profile slots this blueprint binds (MAY be empty). Each entry's resolved scalar value is substituted for the matching `{{ profile.<dotted-path> }}` placeholder; a declared ref absent from the profile, or one never referenced by the body, is a fail-closed render error.
